production_conflicts.detail: The read-only public API does not expose participant UUIDs, provider alias keys, alias targets, or assignment natural keys.

future_packet_requirements: bind the full preimage and stable snapshot hash
delete only exact packet-listed inserts by canonical/natural identity
require the post-rollback hash to equal the pre-bootstrap hash

known_gaps: The production source and the checked-in governed fallback disagree on the current NHL identity. PM must re-ratify one identity before any write.
The sportsbook completeness target has three conflicting values (11 live, 10 checked in, 15 in ratified prose). This bootstrap does not mutate sportsbooks.

A fresh direct production read is still required to enumerate alias keys, source participant UUIDs, and exact preimages. Public API evidence proves the resolution gap but cannot produce those private identifiers.
The approved staging project is unavailable from this host. Both pnpm test:db and prove-staging fail closed locally and must run through the staging-ci GitHub environment.

The lane manifest requires docs/06_status/proof/UTV2-1773/model-routing.json but the ratified file_scope_lock and execution packet do not authorize that path. This implementation did not widen its own scope.

sign_off.note: This bundle returns a governed refusal and a zero-write packet, not authorization to mutate production.
